gloss: to hum; to croon; to sing softly

definitions.gloss: to hum; to croon; to sing softly to oneself
definitions.explanation: To sing or hum a melody quietly, often unconsciously or absent-mindedly. Implies a casual, relaxed mood.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{鼻歌|はなうた}を{口|くち}ずさんでいた。
{散歩|さんぽ}しながら{好|す}きな{曲|きょく}を{口|くち}ずさむのが{日課|にっか}だ。
examples.english: Humming my favorite songs while taking a walk is part of my daily routine.

notes:
To sing or hum softly to oneself, often absent-mindedly or in a relaxed mood. Conveys a warm, gentle image.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を for the song or melody being hummed

ALTERNATIVE WRITING:
Can also be written {口遊|くちずさ}む.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {歌|うた}を{口|くち}ずさむ: to hum a song
- メロディーを{口|くち}ずさむ: to hum a melody
- {口|くち}ずさんでいる: to be humming (ongoing)
- {思|おも}わず{口|くち}ずさむ: to hum without thinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鼻歌|はなうた}を{歌|うた}う: to hum (through the nose)
- {歌|うた}う: to sing (louder, more deliberate)

REGISTER:
Slightly literary. Common in written descriptions and narratives.
